## Analysis of Testable Behaviors **`unescape(String)` — likely bug target:** - Basic named entity: `"&"` → `"&"`, `"<"` → `"<"`, `">"` → `">"`, `"""` → `"\""` - Numeric decimal entity: `"A"` → `"A"` - Numeric hex entity: `"A"` or `"A"` → `"A"` - Entity without trailing semicolon (legacy HTML laxity): e.g. `"&"` → `"&"` depending on base-entity table support - Unknown/invalid entity left unchanged: `"&foo;"` → `"&foo;"` - Plain text with no entities returned unchanged (identity) - Null/empty string handling — empty string → empty string; verify no exception - Multiple entities in one string: `"<p>"` → `"

"` - Entity embedded mid-string with adjacent text: `"a&b"` → `"a&b"` - Case sensitivity: entities are case-sensitive (`&` vs `&` may differ) - Malformed numeric entity (e.g., `"&#;"`, `"&#xZZ;"`) should not crash, stays literal or partially processed **`escape(String, OutputSettings)` — receiver setup:** - Requires a valid `Document.OutputSettings` instance (default constructor) to drive charset/escape mode - Basic special chars escaped: `<`, `>`, `&`, `"` in XML/HTML mode - Non-ASCII chars escaped per charset encoder capability (base vs extended mode) - Empty string input → empty string output **Setup note:** Since methods are package-private (`static`, no modifier), tests must reside in `org.jsoup.nodes` package to access them without reflection.
